705	    /// @dev Verifies investor eligibility to claim token allocation using Merkle proof.
706	    /// @param _investor The address of the investor.
707	    /// @param _amount The amount of tokens to claim.
708	    /// @param _investorVestingConfig The vesting configuration for the investor.
709	    /// @param _proof The Merkle proof for claim verification.
710	    function _verifyCanClaimTokenAllocation(
711	        address _investor,
712	        uint256 _amount,
713	        LegionVestingManager.LegionInvestorVestingConfig calldata _investorVestingConfig,
714	        bytes32[] calldata _proof
715	    )
716	        internal
717	        view
718	        virtual
719	    {
720	        // Get the investor position ID
721	        uint256 positionId = _getInvestorPositionId(_investor);
722	
723	        // Verify that the position exists
724	        _verifyPositionExists(positionId);
725	
726	        // Generate the merkle leaf
727	        bytes32 leaf =
728	            keccak256(bytes.concat(keccak256(abi.encode(_investor, _amount, positionId, _investorVestingConfig))));
729	
730	        // Load the investor position
731	        InvestorPosition memory position = s_investorPositions[positionId];
732	
733	        // Verify the merkle proof
734	        if (!MerkleProofLib.verify(_proof, s_saleStatus.claimTokensMerkleRoot, leaf)) {
735	            revert Errors.LegionSale__NotInClaimWhitelist(_investor);
736	        }
737	
738	        // Check if the investor has already settled their allocation
739	        if (position.hasSettled) revert Errors.LegionSale__AlreadySettled(_investor);
740	    }
741	
742	    /// @dev Verifies investor eligibility to claim excess capital using Merkle proof.
743	    /// @param _investor The address of the investor.
744	    /// @param _positionId The position ID of the investor.
745	    /// @param _amount The amount of excess capital to claim.
746	    /// @param _proof The Merkle proof for excess capital verification.
747	    function _verifyCanClaimExcessCapital(
748	        address _investor,
749	        uint256 _positionId,
750	        uint256 _amount,
751	        bytes32[] calldata _proof
752	    )
753	        internal
754	        view

756	    {
757	        // Load the investor position
758	        InvestorPosition memory position = s_investorPositions[_positionId];
759	
760	        // Check if the investor has already settled their allocation
761	        if (position.hasClaimedExcess) revert Errors.LegionSale__AlreadyClaimedExcess(_investor);
762	
763	        // Generate the merkle leaf and verify accepted capital
